products.title: Fresh Cut Carnations (Bunch)
products.description: Bundle of 10 long-stemmed ruffled carnations with sweet clove fragrance and exceptional 2-week vase life.

symbolism.origin: Linked to the Virgin Mary’s tears at Christ’s crucifixion.

harvest_instructions: Harvest in the cool early morning when stems are fully turgid and hydration is peak.
Cut stems diagonally at a 45-degree angle using sharp, sanitized floral shears.
Strip all foliage from the lower portion of the stems that will sit submerged below the water line.
vase_care: Place immediately into clean, lukewarm water mixed with commercial floral preservative.
Recut stems by 1-2 cm under running water every 2 days to clear air embolisms.
Change vase water completely every 48 hours to prevent bacterial biofilm build-up.
Keep floral vase away from direct sunlight, heating vents, and ripening fruit (ethylene gas).
growing_instructions: Grown under protected polyhouses or field beds in Kashmir; planted in March or October.
Peak flowering and stem harvesting occur from June through August.
Overwinters with root crown protection under straw mulch from December to February.
Fresh cut stems provide 14+ days vase life when water is changed regularly.
